# #3929 (Security's #3965 classification): every route the server serves, and what an agent's
# session token may do there. a: agent-needed (coral-board, coral-agent, the hooks); b: the
# Operator's, refused for an agent token in every mode (operatorOnlyRoutes); c: reachable, left
# open for now (reads, review verdicts, cosmetic names, hub-only routes). A new route fails
# TestAgentRouteCensus until it gets a line here: decide, then add it.
